name: godot_execute_code
description: DANGEROUS: run GDScript in the attached Godot editor (a @tool script, extending RefCounted), given as code or as a script file (path): statements (the body of func run()), or a script with its own func run() and helper functions. In scope: scene (the edited scene's root), EditorInterface, every engine class and singleton. Assign a JSON-able Dictionary to result; print() output is returned. A node you add needs node.owner = scene to be saved. A run that changes the scene is one undo action (OpenCode: code); a failing one (parse or script error) is undone and compared, and its error says what Godot knows (line, closest class, property or method names, real signatures, closest children of a missing node). No await. Every run asks permission.

path.description: A .gd file to run instead of code, read as is (absolute or relative to the conversation's folder).

read_only.description: Inspection: no undo action, the scene is not compared.
